At lower right a neutral anonymous cloaked Guardian stands BESIDE a tall lever, with small familiar lantern hanging at their belt. They do not pull the lever. River carved below still flows. Ambiguous historical clue, no catastrophe, no villain, no asserted intention. Cool slate teal and muted gold carved highlights, chunky readable pixel clusters intended to downsample to 128x80. All objects contained in panel with simple stone border. No UI, no perspective, no realism.
